family: All Boolean carriers h on d=1,2,3, every event A contained in h-positive vertices with density <=1/2; private V=y. Additional fixed balanced Maj3 profile on the first 128 admissible d=3 pairs.
parameter_domain: d=1,2,3 fixed; p=0 included as a boundary control; no automatic escalation
case_count: Exact count computed by binomial sum sum_{d=1}^3 sum_{k=0}^{2^{d-1}} binom(2^d,k)2^{2^d-k}; plus 128 Maj3 roots
symmetry: None; all labeled carriers and admissible events enumerated
arithmetic: Integer Walsh, rational edges, outward rational logarithm intervals; no floating-point sign decisions
full: d=1,2,3 exhaustive with 128 fixed Maj3 extras; same 55s cap
hypothesis_controls: p=0,p=1/2; events meeting carrier pivotal edges; h constant; biased V with correct mean law explicitly outside theorem; A not contained in positive carrier checked as exclusion
